dataset.missing_data_policy: Eligibility uses complete training histories only; later missing prices fail the run. No filling or interpolation.

model.method: Greedy support selection + constrained ridge least squares
model.selection_rule: Normalize holding budget and validation RMSE to [0,1]; minimize the weighted squared distance from the ideal (smallest budget, lowest error). Equal default importance for simplicity and precision. Grid-dependent heuristic, not a global optimum.
model.evaluation: Supports selected on training only; size selected on validation only; weights refit on train + validation; test never used for selection.

warnings: All prices, symbols, weights and performance in this demo are simulated. They do not describe the S&P 500 or real investments.
The simulation uses weekdays, not the exchange holiday calendar.
